# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man with a wide, round face covered in freckles that is normally devoid of expression. When pleased, he displays a joyful smile and glows with satisfaction.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Personality

Barney possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an inability to hold a conversation. Extremely timid and bashful, he relied on his sister to propose marriage on his behalf. Despite his silence and bashfulness, he works extremely hard, is reliable, possesses good sense, lacks negative vices, and is capable of showing vast admiration for those he fancies.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## Traits

- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Bashful and timid  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Hardworking and reliable  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Possesses good sense  <sub>[v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and establish his own household on the upper farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

Barney lived in Brierley as part of the Pullen family, often driving his buggy to local events accompanied by his sister Odette. Harboring a long-standing admiration for Nell Harcourt, he had his sister propose marriage to Nell on his behalf after his father granted him ownership of the upper farm, as he was too bashful to ask her directly. When Nell firmly rejected the proposal, Barney quickly moved on due to his practical sense. He soon turned his attentions to Nettie Scobie, whom his mother favored, and married her shortly after, making their first public appearance as husband and wife at the local church.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Belongs to the Pullen family of Brierley  <sub>[v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- Was gifted the upper farm under his own name by his father  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
